The appeal path, quoted from POL-GEN-04

Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.

POL-GEN-05: the monetary effect is SGD 83.42 against an execution threshold of SGD 8.00. It exceeds the threshold, so the amount is issued but not executed: it is held for release and the case is placed in the human queue.

The judge's explanation, as written

To the rider and to the driver. What happened. A ride booked as 2.4 km / 5 minutes from Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6 to Blk 7 Everton Park (TRP-02823) was driven as 67.2 km in 101.5 minutes and charged SGD 83.42. 1. The deviation is established and is material. POL-RD-01 measures actual distance from the GPS polyline, and gps_trace.trace_distance_km on EV-GPS-02823 is 67.2 km — the governing figure, not the rounded copy on the trip record. Against the booked optimal of 2.4 km (EV-TRIP-02823) the excess is 64.8 km, or 2700%. Both establishment tests pass (more than 20% of optimal and more than 0.8 km), and the excess is additionally MATERIAL (more than 50% and more than 8.0 km). The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07: 610 fixes at 10-second sampling, 100.0% coverage, gaps empty, max_gap_sec 0.0, so the deviation stands on the trace alone and no corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises. 2. The driver's explanation carries no weight and is discarded. The driver's account is that the rider changed the destination verbally. It cites no evidence, and no artifact supports it. EV-CHAT-02823 is a complete chat log for this trip holding 0 messages — nothing from which a waypoint_hint could be resolved, and no road named — and EV-TRIP-02823 shows pickup_amended_at null, dropoff_amended_at null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so no endpoint was amended and no amended re-quote exists. Under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence carries no weight and is discarded; POL-RD-04 is unavailable on its own terms ('where waypoint_hint is null and no road is named, the corroboration test is undecidable on the record: the clause is unavailable, the case is decided on the remaining clauses'); POL-RD-05 never engages, because it is conditioned on a recorded amendment and the record shows none. The driver's separate submission that the empty record is 'consistent with a destination agreed in the vehicle' is an argument from silence and is rejected: the chat log is complete ('sequence numbering intact'), the trip record is complete, and the only thing missing from the bundle is evidence for the driver's own account. 3. Why this is not an ESCALATE. POL-RD-10(5) fires where an exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited artifact that is missing from the pool, does not cover the trip window, or lacks the field the clause requires. The two artifacts the driver's side cites are neither missing nor outside the window: EV-CHAT-02823 and EV-TRIP-02823 are both present, COMPLETE and weighted 1.0. POL-RD-10(5)'s examples are all artifacts that ought to exist and do not — no chat_log for the trip, no traffic_advisory, an amendment with a null re-quote — and none matches an empty-but-complete chat log. What the record shows is that the driver's excuse has nothing behind it, which POL-RD-08 answers by discarding the assertion, not by escalating. No other POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-02823) and the trace's first fix at 2026-08-21T08:28:00+08:00 matches started_at; no timestamps run backwards; no charge line lacks a counterpart (erp_lines total 0.00, tolls 0.0, airport_surcharge 0.0 on a trip that ended at Everton Park and did not originate at an airport); the computed refund does not exceed SGD 150.00 or charged_total; and there is no mutually contradictory evidence of comparable strength, because the driver's account is supported by no artifact at all. POL-RD-13 is confined to asserted external traffic causes and therefore does not decide this case; the result here is reached on POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-04 directly. I record the open question for the reader rather than as a referral: whether the rider directed the change in the vehicle is simply unevidenced on this bundle. 4. The remedy is arithmetic. fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and POL-RD-02 governs. vehicle_type is RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The surge multiplier, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, is 1.0. recomputed_fare = (base fare 3.80 + 0.75 x 2.4 km = 1.80 + 0.28 x 5.0 min = 1.40) x 1.0 + platform fee 0.80 = 7.80, with no ERP, no tolls, no fixed surcharge, no waiting time and no promo. charged_total = 83.42. Refund = 83.42 - 7.80 = 75.62, above the SGD 0.50 de minimis. That refund is 90.65% of charged_total — 90% or more — so POL-RD-02 requires FULL_REFUND rather than a partial, and under POL-GEN-03 FULL_REFUND returns the whole contested amount: SGD 83.42. The POL-RD-02 arithmetic figure, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, is 75.65; both figures are read off the fare_breakdown money block, and the ruling carries the full-refund figure the 90% rule selects. Nothing is added on top: there are no ERP or toll lines to itemise or refund under POL-RD-09, no double-count risk under POL-RD-09(1), and no phantom or unmatched line, so no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral arises. 5. Driver compensation and conduct. None. The billed distance (67.2 km) equals the traced distance, so there is no unbilled shortfall and POL-RD-04's compensation limb pays nothing. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 210, so the POL-RD-06 pattern is not established on either limb (not 3 or more; 0/210 below 0.05), and consequently no FULL_REFUND uplift under limb (b) and no driver-conduct referral under limb (c). The rider's FULL_REFUND rests on POL-RD-02's own 90% rule, not on the driver's history. On profile use, POL-GEN-01 governs: only deviation_flags_90d and completed_trips_90d (POL-RD-06) and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d (POL-RD-08) have been used, and the context-only counters named in the debate — prior_deviation_flags, prior_no_show_flags, rating, lifetime_trips, cancellation_rate, acceptance_rate — have not been relied on and are not a ground of this decision. 6. Position and execution. payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.0, so this is a live charge filed by the rider and the refund is what moves the money; under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION would simply have left it standing. The monetary effect (SGD 83.42) exceeds the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling issues but is not executed automatically: the amount is held and the case is placed in the human queue for release, where the reviewer confirms execution or converts the case to a review under POL-GEN-06. Either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

What each side argued

The rider advocate

kept The trip record and the trace agree that a 2.4 km booking was driven as 67.2 km. POL-RD-01 measures actual distance from the gps_trace polyline, and gps_trace.trace_distance_km (67.2 km) governs over the rounded trip_record copy; against the booked optimal of 2.4 km the derived excess is 64.8 km, or 2700% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (excess greater than 20% of optimal AND greater than 0.8 km absolute), and the excess is additionally MATERIAL because it exceeds 50% of optimal and 8.0 km absolute, so POL-RD-06's driver_profile check is engaged.

evidence EV-GPS-02823, EV-TRIP-02823 · clauses POL-RD-01

kept The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged. trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip_id TRP-02823, and the trace's first fix at 2026-08-21T08:28:00+08:00 matches the trip_record's started_at of 2026-08-21T08:28:00+08:00, so the artifacts describe the same trip and the same pickup event. The burden therefore shifts to the driver to name a specific artifact and clause, and he names none.

evidence EV-TRIP-02823, EV-GPS-02823, EV-FARE-02823 · clauses POL-RD-08

kept The trace is not impaired for policy purposes. It carries 610 fixes at a 10.0 second sampling interval with 100.0% coverage, gaps is empty and max_gap_sec is 0.0, so none of limbs (a) to (c) of POL-RD-07 is met. The deviation therefore stands on the trace alone and needs no independent corroboration of the kind POL-RD-07(ii) lists; POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged.

evidence EV-GPS-02823 · clauses POL-RD-07, POL-RD-08

kept The fare model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not close the distance-and-time refund route and POL-RD-02 governs the remedy. The surge multiplier is read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier and is 1.0, so no uplift or discount distorts the recomputation.

evidence EV-FARE-02823 · clauses POL-RD-11, POL-RD-02

kept The vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline does not apply and the 2.4 km booked optimal is the correct baseline for the POL-RD-01 test. There is no co-rider distance to exclude and no solo-optimal/matched-optimal confusion in this case.

evidence EV-TRIP-02823 · clauses POL-RD-12

kept No traffic advisory covers this corridor. EV-ADVIS-02823-01 is impaired: its admissibility status is MISSING, its weight_multiplier is 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT fired ('No advisory covers the Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6 corridor in this window'). The absence is itself citable, and it means POL-RD-03's three-part test - named road on the optimal route, overlapping validity window, actual route leaving and rejoining the corridor - cannot be run, so no external-cause exoneration, and no closure-adjusted optimal under POL-RD-03, is available to the driver.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02823-01 · clauses POL-RD-03, POL-GEN-02

kept POL-RD-04 cannot be run in the driver's favour. Limb (a) requires an instruction from the rider recorded in the chat_log, and the chat log holds 0 messages with no first or last message timestamp, so there is no instruction, no message text from which a waypoint_hint could have been resolved, and no named road. On the clause's own terms it is unavailable and the case is decided on the remaining clauses.

evidence EV-CHAT-02823, EV-TRIP-02823 · clauses POL-RD-04, POL-RD-08

kept POL-RD-05 cannot excuse any part of the excess either. The trip_record shows pickup_amended_at null, dropoff_amended_at null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so no endpoint was amended and there is no amended optimal to re-apply POL-RD-01 against. The driver's counterparty statement - 'The rider changed the destination verbally' - cites no evidence ID at all and is contradicted by the empty chat log and the absent amendment, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight and is discarded.

evidence EV-TRIP-02823, EV-CHAT-02823 · clauses POL-RD-05, POL-RD-08

kept No mandatory escalation trigger fires, so the case can and should be ruled on this record rather than held. The identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown; the trace is unimpaired under POL-RD-07; the computed refund of 75.62 does not exceed SGD 150.00 and does not exceed charged_total of 83.42; there is no mutually contradictory evidence of comparable strength; and no charge line lacks a counterpart (erp_lines total 0.00, airport_surcharge 0.0). Every deciding artifact carries weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap is 1.0 and is above the 0.70 floor.

evidence EV-TRIP-02823, EV-GPS-02823, EV-FARE-02823 · clauses POL-RD-10, POL-GEN-02

kept The POL-RD-02 recomputation is fixed by the fare_breakdown's own derived money block: recomputed_fare is 7.80 (base fare 3.80, distance 0.75 x 2.4 km = 1.80, time 0.28 x 5.0 min = 1.40, all at a surge_multiplier of 1.0, plus the 0.80 platform fee, with no ERP, no fixed surcharge, no waiting time and no promo). Refund_before_rounding is 75.62, the payable figure rounded UP to the nearest SGD 0.05 is 75.65, and refund_share_of_charged is 0.9065 - 90% or more of charged_total 83.42.

evidence EV-FARE-02823, EV-TRIP-02823 · clauses POL-RD-02

kept Because the refund reaches 90% or more of charged_total, POL-RD-02 requires FULL_REFUND rather than a partial, and POL-GEN-03 defines FULL_REFUND as the filing party being entirely right with the whole contested amount returned - so the rider should recover the full SGD 83.42 charged. On the narrowest reading of POL-RD-02 the amount is the 75.65 payable, which is itself above the 90% line; either way the refund is far above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and rounding applies only to the final payable figure.

evidence EV-FARE-02823 · clauses POL-RD-02, POL-GEN-03

evidence EV-FARE-02823 · clauses POL-RD-09, POL-RD-02

Under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION ruling on a rider-filed dispute leaves that state standing, so the contested amount would simply be kept; the arithmetic refund is what moves the money back.

evidence EV-FARE-02823 · clauses POL-GEN-03, POL-RD-02

kept The rider's claim needs no corroboration beyond the trace: rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d is 0 and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated is 0, so POL-RD-08's extra-corroboration condition (4 or more claims with 1 or fewer substantiated) is not engaged and cannot be used to demand anything more than the unimpaired trace already shows.

evidence EV-RPROF-02823 · clauses POL-RD-08

kept I do not press POL-RD-06, and I say so rather than stretch it: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 and completed_trips_90d is 210, so neither limb of the pattern test is met (neither 3 or more flags, nor a ratio of 0.05 or more on at least 40 trips), and no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c) arise on this record. evidence EV-DPROF-02823 · clauses POL-RD-06

The driver advocate

kept This trip's deviation is material on the platform's own numbers — derived.deviation.excess_km is 64.8 km and derived.deviation.excess_pct is 2700 against a 2.4 km optimal route, both far past POL-RD-01's material gates of 8.0 km / 50% — so POL-RD-06 makes the driver_profile the decisive check, and that check comes back clean: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against driver_profile.completed_trips_90d of 210. The pattern test fails on both limbs (0 is below 3, and 0/210 is below 0.05); no pattern is ESTABLISHED, so neither consequence POL-RD-06 attaches actually fires — limb (b) does not license a FULL_REFUND of charged_total on top of the POL-RD-02 figure, and limb (c) does not generate a driver-conduct referral. No other counter may be substituted to repair that gap: POL-GEN-01 makes prior_deviation_flags, prior_no_show_flags, rating, lifetime_trips, cancellation_rate and acceptance_rate context only, and a finding built on any of them is discarded on the same footing as an uncited claim.

evidence EV-DPROF-02823, EV-TRIP-02823, EV-GPS-02823 · clauses POL-RD-06, POL-GEN-01

kept The driver's account on file is that the rider changed the destination verbally. That is precisely the exculpatory route POL-RD-04 and POL-RD-05 exist to recognise, and on this record neither clause can be run in either direction: EV-CHAT-02823 carries message_count 0 and no waypoint_hint, so POL-RD-04's rider-instruction test and its 200 m corroboration test have nothing to operate on, and EV-TRIP-02823 shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null with amended_optimal_distance_km null, so the amended re-quote POL-RD-05 requires does not exist in the record. These are exculpatory clauses invoked against cited artifacts that lack the fields the clauses require — the very case POL-RD-10(5) names, 'a rider-requested detour asserted with no chat_log for the trip'. The consequence is mandatory and terminal: the Judge may not issue a monetary ruling under POL-RD-02 on this record, and must ESCALATE to a human reviewer with the disputed amount held rather than collected or refunded. Whether the rider did or did not direct the change is the fact the whole dispute turns on, and no artifact in this bundle carries it.

evidence EV-CHAT-02823, EV-TRIP-02823, EV-GPS-02823 · clauses POL-RD-10, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05

Nor does POL-RD-13(1)'s uncited-identifier carve-out apply, because the driver has cited the artifact POL-RD-04 requires, EV-CHAT-02823, and the clause says in terms that where the party does cite the identifier the case still escalates. The rider-instruction route through POL-RD-04 and POL-RD-05 is therefore untouched by POL-RD-13, and POL-RD-10(5) governs it as written.

evidence EV-ADVIS-02823-01, EV-CHAT-02823 · clauses POL-RD-13, POL-RD-10

kept The only contemporaneous record of the journey is consistent with the driver's account and contradicts nothing in it. EV-GPS-02823 is a complete, gap-free trace — 610 fixes at 10-second sampling, coverage 100%, max_gap_sec 0.0 — showing one continuous 101.5-minute run from Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6 to a single drop-off at Blk 7 Everton Park, with no circling and no interrupted segment. Each draft's own explanation

To the rider and to the driver. What happened. A ride booked as 2.4 km / 5 minutes from Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6 to Blk 7 Everton Park (TRP-02823) was driven as 67.2 km in 101.5 minutes and charged SGD 83.42. 1. The deviation is established and is material. POL-RD-01 measures actual distance from the GPS polyline, and gps_trace.trace_distance_km on EV-GPS-02823 is 67.2 km — the governing figure, not the rounded copy on the trip record. Against the booked optimal of 2.4 km (EV-TRIP-02823) the excess is 64.8 km, or 2700%. Both establishment tests pass (more than 20% of optimal and more than 0.8 km), and the excess is additionally MATERIAL (more than 50% and more than 8.0 km). The trace is not impaired under POL-RD-07: 610 fixes at 10-second sampling, 100.0% coverage, gaps empty, max_gap_sec 0.0, so the deviation stands on the trace alone and no corroboration under POL-RD-07(ii) and no POL-RD-10(3) escalation arises. 2. The driver's explanation carries no weight and is discarded. The driver's account is that the rider changed the destination verbally. It cites no evidence, and no artifact supports it. EV-CHAT-02823 is a complete chat log for this trip holding 0 messages — nothing from which a waypoint_hint could be resolved, and no road named — and EV-TRIP-02823 shows pickup_amended_at null, dropoff_amended_at null and amended_optimal_distance_km null, so no endpoint was amended and no amended re-quote exists. Under POL-RD-08 an assertion that cites no evidence carries no weight and is discarded; POL-RD-04 is unavailable on its own terms ('where waypoint_hint is null and no road is named, the corroboration test is undecidable on the record: the clause is unavailable, the case is decided on the remaining clauses'); POL-RD-05 never engages, because it is conditioned on a recorded amendment and the record shows none. The driver's separate submission that the empty record is 'consistent with a destination agreed in the vehicle' is an argument from silence and is rejected: the chat log is complete ('sequence numbering intact'), the trip record is complete, and the only thing missing from the bundle is evidence for the driver's own account. 3. Why this is not an ESCALATE. POL-RD-10(5) fires where an exculpatory clause is invoked against a cited artifact that is missing from the pool, does not cover the trip window, or lacks the field the clause requires. The two artifacts the driver's side cites are neither missing nor outside the window: EV-CHAT-02823 and EV-TRIP-02823 are both present, COMPLETE and weighted 1.0. POL-RD-10(5)'s examples are all artifacts that ought to exist and do not — no chat_log for the trip, no traffic_advisory, an amendment with a null re-quote — and none matches an empty-but-complete chat log. What the record shows is that the driver's excuse has nothing behind it, which POL-RD-08 answers by discarding the assertion, not by escalating. No other POL-RD-10 trigger fires: the trip identifiers match across trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown (TRP-02823) and the trace's first fix at 2026-08-21T08:28:00+08:00 matches started_at; no timestamps run backwards; no charge line lacks a counterpart (erp_lines total 0.00, tolls 0.0, airport_surcharge 0.0 on a trip that ended at Everton Park and did not originate at an airport); the computed refund does not exceed SGD 150.00 or charged_total; and there is no mutually contradictory evidence of comparable strength, because the driver's account is supported by no artifact at all. POL-RD-13 is confined to asserted external traffic causes and therefore does not decide this case; the result here is reached on POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-04 directly. I record the open question for the reader rather than as a referral: whether the rider directed the change in the vehicle is simply unevidenced on this bundle. 4. The remedy is arithmetic. fare_breakdown.fare_model is METERED and quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply and POL-RD-02 governs. vehicle_type is RYDE_X, so POL-RD-12 does not apply. The surge multiplier, read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier, is 1.0. recomputed_fare = (base fare 3.80 + 0.75 x 2.4 km = 1.80 + 0.28 x 5.0 min = 1.40) x 1.0 + platform fee 0.80 = 7.80, with no ERP, no tolls, no fixed surcharge, no waiting time and no promo. charged_total = 83.42. Refund = 83.42 - 7.80 = 75.62, above the SGD 0.50 de minimis. That refund is 90.65% of charged_total — 90% or more — so POL-RD-02 requires FULL_REFUND rather than a partial, and under POL-GEN-03 FULL_REFUND returns the whole contested amount: SGD 83.42. The POL-RD-02 arithmetic figure, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05, is 75.65; both figures are read off the fare_breakdown money block, and the ruling carries the full-refund figure the 90% rule selects. Nothing is added on top: there are no ERP or toll lines to itemise or refund under POL-RD-09, no double-count risk under POL-RD-09(1), and no phantom or unmatched line, so no POL-RD-09(4) billing-integrity referral arises. 5. Driver compensation and conduct. None. The billed distance (67.2 km) equals the traced distance, so there is no unbilled shortfall and POL-RD-04's compensation limb pays nothing. driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against completed_trips_90d of 210, so the POL-RD-06 pattern is not established on either limb (not 3 or more; 0/210 below 0.05), and consequently no FULL_REFUND uplift under limb (b) and no driver-conduct referral under limb (c). The rider's FULL_REFUND rests on POL-RD-02's own 90% rule, not on the driver's history. On profile use, POL-GEN-01 governs: only deviation_flags_90d and completed_trips_90d (POL-RD-06) and rider_profile.deviation_claims_60d (POL-RD-08) have been used, and the context-only counters named in the debate — prior_deviation_flags, prior_no_show_flags, rating, lifetime_trips, cancellation_rate, acceptance_rate — have not been relied on and are not a ground of this decision. 6. Position and execution. payment_status is CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd is 0.0, so this is a live charge filed by the rider and the refund is what moves the money; under POL-GEN-03 a NO_ACTION would simply have left it standing. The monetary effect (SGD 83.42) exceeds the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so this provisional ruling issues but is not executed automatically: the amount is held and the case is placed in the human queue for release, where the reviewer confirms execution or converts the case to a review under POL-GEN-06. Either party may appeal once within 30 days under POL-GEN-04.
To the rider and to the driver. The deviation is established. TRP-02823 was booked as a 2.4 km ride from Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6 to Blk 7 Everton Park and was driven as 67.2 km over 101.5 minutes. POL-RD-01 measures actual distance from the GPS trace, and gps_trace.trace_distance_km (67.2 km, EV-GPS-02823) governs over the trip record's rounded copy; the excess over the 2.4 km booked optimal (EV-TRIP-02823) is 64.8 km, or 2700%. Both establishment tests (over 20% of optimal and over 0.8 km absolute) and both materiality gates (over 50% and over 8.0 km) are passed, so the POL-RD-06 driver_profile check is engaged. The trace is not impaired. EV-GPS-02823 carries 610 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps and a maximum gap of 0 seconds, so none of POL-RD-07(a)-(c) is met. The deviation stands on the trace alone, no independent corroboration is required, and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. The driver's explanation does not answer the case. The statement that the rider changed the destination verbally is supported by no artifact. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02823) is complete and holds 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction and no waypoint_hint; and the trip record shows pickup_amended_at, dropoff_amended_at and amended_optimal_distance_km all null, so no endpoint was amended and there is no stored re-quote. Under POL-RD-08 the driver must point to a specific artifact and clause that excuse the excess, and an assertion resting on nothing discharges nothing. POL-RD-04 cannot be run (no rider instruction in the chat log) and POL-RD-05 cannot be run (no amendment), and POL-RD-04 itself directs that where its route cannot be run the case is decided on the remaining clauses. No traffic cause is asserted, so the missing advisory EV-ADVIS-02823-01 (status MISSING, weight_multiplier 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT) carries and excuses nothing, and POL-RD-13 is not the operative clause either way. I do not escalate under POL-RD-10(5): the cited chat log is present and complete for this trip, and the driver's account cites no artifact at all - an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, and this is a failed exculpation rather than an untestable one. The driver's further point, that a long quiet ride is 'at least as consistent' with a verbal agreement, is an inference from silence rather than evidence, and a record that merely exists is not a carrier of a fact; it does not rebut the numbers. To both parties. The disputed charge on trip TRP-02823 is SGD 83.42. The platform's GPS trace is complete and unimpaired for policy purposes under POL-RD-07 — 610 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100% coverage, no gaps and no jumps — so it governs the distance measurement under POL-RD-01. It records 67.2 km driven between the booked pickup (Blk 412 Pasir Ris Dr 6) and the booked drop-off (Blk 7 Everton Park) against a booked optimal route of 2.4 km: an excess of 64.8 km, 2,700% of optimal, and material on both POL-RD-01 tests (over 8.0 km and over 50%). The deviation is established, and it stands on the trace alone because POL-RD-07's impairment limbs are not met and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged. The driver's explanation on file — that the rider changed the destination verbally — is not carried by any artifact. The chat log EV-CHAT-02823 holds zero messages, so there is no rider instruction to test under POL-RD-04; EV-TRIP-02823 shows no amended pickup or drop-off and no amended optimal distance, so POL-RD-05 cannot run; and the statement cites no evidence ID, so under POL-RD-08 it carries no weight and is discarded. I do not accept the driver's submission that this forces a human escalation under POL-RD-10(5). A party who cites no artifact cannot have invoked an exculpatory clause 'against' one; the chat log is a complete artifact present in the bundle (not a missing or field-less one), and the rider-requested-detour example in POL-RD-10(5) is the case where no chat log is in the pool at all. POL-RD-04's own terms provide that where its test cannot be run the case is decided on the remaining clauses, and POL-RD-08 provides that an assertion citing no evidence ID discharges nothing. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02823-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, but no traffic cause was asserted by anyone, so POL-RD-03 is simply unavailable and nothing turns on the absence. The driver's further point — that a silent 101.5-minute ride is as consistent with an agreed destination as with a detour — does not assist: silence is not assent and is equally consistent with the rider's account. The remedy is arithmetic under POL-RD-02. The fare model is METERED, quoted_fare_sgd is null, and the surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier is 1.0. Recomputed fare = (SGD 3.80 base + 0.75 x 2.4 km + 0.28 x 5.0 min) x 1.0 + SGD 0.80 platform fee = SGD 7.80, with no ERP, no fixed surcharge, no waiting time and no promo. Charged total SGD 83.42 less SGD 7.80 = SGD 75.62, rounded up to SGD 75.65, which is 90.65% of the charge. Because the refund is 90% or more of charged_total, POL-RD-02 requires FULL_REFUND rather than a partial, and POL-GEN-03 defines FULL_REFUND as the whole contested amount returned. The rider therefore recovers SGD 83.42, and the driver receives no compensation: the billed distance (67.2 km) equals the trace distance, so the POL-RD-04 unbilled-distance limb has a nil shortfall and does not run. There is nothing to settle under POL-RD-09 — no ERP gantries, no tolls and no airport surcharge were charged — so no pass-through correction and no billing-integrity referral arises. The POL-RD-06 driver-profile check was consulted because the deviation is material; driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 210 completed trips in 90 days, so no repeat pattern is established and neither the FULL_REFUND uplift of limb (b) nor the driver-conduct referral of limb (c) follows. No other profile field was used, and the context-only fields named in argument carry no weight under POL-GEN-01. No mandatory escalation trigger fires: the trip identifiers match across trip record, trace and fare breakdown, the trace is unimpaired, the refund is under both the SGD 150.00 and charged-total limits, and every charge line has a counterpart. Confidence rests on artifacts all at weight 1.0. This is a provisional ruling made without human review; because its monetary effect (SGD 83.42) exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, the amount is held for release by a reviewer, and either party may appeal within 30 days.
